evidence.evidence_text: Weakly supervised natural language video localization (WS-NLVL) aims to retrieve the moment corresponding to a language query in a video with only video-language pairs utilized during training.
Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of our method on the Charades-STA and ActivityNet Captions datasets.

In this paper, we propose a novel plug-and-play method, Intrinsic Multilateral Logical Rules, namely IMLR, to exploit intrinsic temporal relations and logical rules for WS-NLVL.
